_comment: A cooldown that charms the nearest wildlife mob in a 4-unit radius, turning it into a full companion for 1800 ticks plus 150 per level: it fights for the caster, its kills count as the caster's, and it keeps its own level throughout. When the charm ends it reverts to its normal allegiance and turns hostile on whoever is nearest; it cannot be renewed, only recast. All values placeholder.
name: CharmBeast
description: It keeps its own level, and turns on you when the charm ends.
